summary: Hempuli's Baba Is You is a rules-manipulation puzzle game with PC, Switch, and mobile routes, plus major editor/custom-level updates after launch.

entries.title: Baba Is You
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC build with editor/custom-level and 2026 update state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with level editor/update state documented

primary.why: The PC build is the best archive route because it supports current patches, the level editor/custom-level ecosystem, and clean capture. Switch is an excellent console route, while mobile versions have different editor/custom-level limitations and should be labeled separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC build from Steam or itch.io. Record build/version, world/level, completion state, level editor/custom-level state, language, input device, undo/restart settings, and whether the 2026 final-large-update content/objects/rulewords are present.

secondary.why: PC remains better for editor/custom-level and capture documentation.

secondary.why: Mobile does not necessarily match PC editor/custom-level behavior.
